Create a polished child-friendly Charlie Party cartoon in soft cel shading, smooth rounded forms, bold navy outlines, pastel candy colors, no text. Wall ends at y=400; honey-wood floorboards below. Huge round scalloped rug centered (960,735), ellipse radius 640x300, pink/mint/cream rings, polka dots, yellow star at center. Fluffy pom-pom cheer mats at far left x16-196 and far right x1724-1904, y460-980.
